title: Contorso - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Contorso in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Contorso is a lightning-element weapon used by Gustave / Verso. It scales with Defense (A), Agility (S).

sections.title: Is the Contorso Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Defense (A), Agility (S). A dedicated lightning pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
